'''Dambala''' is a [[Meso-Titan]] who appears as a large green serpent with her body decorated with green patches. She is similar in appearance to and has the same base stats as [[Salamandrake]].

== History ==
Dambala is a very wild [[Titan]] and is not easily controlled by its [[Seeker]]. A group of [[Suits]] once tried in vain to capture a Dambala Titan. {{Source|TCG:OAL-036|OAL-036}}

== Abilities ==
Dambala's great size and well-built body gives her a real advantage in battle. Her 'Lunge' ability allows her to stretch her way forward and to move great distances with great speed.

== Trivia ==
